provenance_caveats: The protocol-manifest SHA-256 is not embedded in the nine checkpoint configs; the audit establishes an exact semantic match to the current reviewed manifest.
The fold-index SHA-256 is enforced by the submission wrapper but is not embedded in checkpoint provenance; each individual fold-manifest SHA-256 is embedded and verified.
The model-weight digests are verified against reviewed locks and against the metadata validated during embedding loads; this audit does not reinterpret those custom weight hashes.

The current remote entrypoint has changed since these runs. All nine checkpoints embed one common run-time source hash set, but the exact entrypoint bytes are no longer present at the live source path. This is source-archival drift, not evidence of metric or checkpoint contamination.
scope: train-only antigen-fold architecture selection; no fixed holdout evaluation

selection_validity_assessment.assessment: The caveats weaken bitwise launch provenance but do not invalidate the independently recomputed metrics, fold-wise macro selection, or winner.
